name: Woven Wrap Accessory

assembly.instruction: Sew the accent strip to the main wrap along the 2.5 cm seam allowance.
Attach the second accent strip to the main wrap at the designated point.

instructions: Cut out the main wrap and accent strips according to the provided polygons.
Hem the main wrap along the 1 cm allowance.
Sew the accent strips to the main wrap along the 2.5 cm seam allowance.
Attach the second accent strip to the main wrap at the designated point.
limitations: The proposed design assumes a plain weave cotton fabric with a weight of 200 gsm. The actual fabric properties may vary.
The assembly instructions are based on the provided geometry and may require adjustments based on the actual fabric and sewing conditions.
